scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “Electromagnetic tails and the Kerr–Newman Penrose inequality” (preprints/Electromagnetic-tails-and-the-Kerr-Newman-Penrose-inequality-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ffdf93f60ad3ab23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sufficiently large fixed L, there exists s∗ ∈ (0, 1) such that D(s∗, L) = 0. These equality data satisfy the strict branch (5.10) and have no Kerr–Newman realization with the specified asymptotic parameters and induced fields.
